quirk.message: `+hascom` can never be true in 5.42 (the commander lookup runs with no square); `-hascom` always passes
in a squareevent the first square short of units ends the whole event, not just that square
a count of three or more digits is not understood and creates one unit; use dice (e.g. `3d6*`) or a count up to 99
this event command aborts the game in 5.42 (fatal error "rd: bad ct")
